rationale.conceptual: The method uses established DFTB and QM/MM embedding, but the specific construction of the embedded cluster (link atoms, BCTC neutralization, carving of the silica cavity) and interpretation of the paper’s modelling choices require careful implementation and a sound understanding of computational condensed matter physics. It is not a simple, off-the-shelf script.
rationale.execution: The reproduction pipeline comprises quartz cell optimization, building two distinct atomic models (embedded cluster and periodic supercell), running two separate SCC-DFTB MD+optimization jobs with a specially tuned thermostat protocol, and postprocessing to compute coordination deviations. This involves a specialist external tool (DFTB+), several interdependent stages, and non-trivial input preparation, making it a moderately complex orchestration.
